propositions: Hand-rolled argument parsing loops in claim.py and transition.py must be refactored to use stdlib argparse without changing observable CLI behavior.
--force accepts both inline --force=reason and space-separated forms; bare --force defaults to '(no reason given)'; --reason must not be repurposed as the force note.
--assignee absence maps to None (triggering default_assignee fallback) while explicit --assignee="" clears it; value-less --assignee at end exits with code 1.
Unknown tokens are silently skipped via parse_known_args; --help is auto-generated from argparse flag definitions; prefix abbreviations like --for do not match --force.
transition._parse_flags is retained as argparse-backed shim returning the identical 5-tuple to preserve its three external direct callers.
Retired --force-close flag keeps its exit-1 rejection with existing error message; value-less/invalid-flag errors exit 1 not argparse's default exit-2.
